title: CareLine Courtesy Share on Installation Jobs Failed-Access Fees
content:
**CareLine courtesy on failed-access fees — Installation Jobs**

A customer holding an active plan of **CareLine Service Plans** gets a courtesy share on the failed-access fee charged on an **Installation Jobs** record. The fee is multiplied by that share:

| Customer's active service holding | Courtesy share |
|---|---|
| CareLine Premier Plan, CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan or CareLine Estate Plan | 0.75 |
| CareLine Basic Plan or CareLine Plus Plan | 0.9 |
| no active CareLine plan, or only an On-Call Service Account | one |

The plan read is the customer's CareLine plan whose status is active.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- A fee figure of 200.00 for a customer with an active CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan: 150.00.
- The same figure for a customer with an active CareLine Plus Plan: 180.00.
- The same figure for a customer whose only service holding is an On-Call Service Account: 200.00.
